description: Send a Yo push notification to your owner. Recommended: include a short subject explaining what the notification is about, and a context_url when there is a useful link to open. The subject appears on the lock screen and in the app; avoid secrets. Requires an agent API key as the Bearer token.

context_url.description: Optional https or app deep-link URL opened when the user taps the notification

subject.description: Recommended: a short, specific subject explaining why you are notifying the user (1–120 characters, counted as Unicode code points), e.g. "PR ready for review". Plain text, one line; avoid secrets because it appears on the lock screen. Optional for compatibility with older agents.

name: yo
